thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Investigating elevated tail latency and 504s for hosted inference in apac (apac1 region). Some customer requests failing. Details & public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1847654321

oncall-tom: I'm taking lead. Triage in progress — checking autoscaler, queue depth, and recent rollout. @sre-jen you good to join?

sre-jen: on it. seeing sustained backlog on queue-worker-apac-1 and many goroutines stuck on kv-cache fetch. CPU on inference-host-12 spiked to 98%.

eng-raj: I noticed a model rollout to v3.1.2 in apac started ~20m ago. rolling back that rollout to v3.1.1 now (canary -> full). Patching rollout...

eng-runtime: enabling fallback routing to rdx-small for >1s requests and diverting non-critical batch traffic to eu-region as stopgap. Applying routing policy change.

sre-jen: started manual scale up of inference-apac deployment to 10 replicas to drain queues. Command:```kubectl scale deployment inference-apac --replicas=10 -n hosted-inference```

oncall-tom: also applied temporary rate-limits for free-tier and new customers to reduce burstiness. threshold=120r/s per org.

support-maria: sending templated customer notifics now. Posting update to status page (customer-facing): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1847654321 — will paste copy below for review.

product-lina: reached out to 3 largest APAC customers proactively, flagged mitigation steps. prepping internal FAQ for CS.

dl-runbook-bot: Runbook invoked: apac-hosted-latency (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-hosted-latency). Steps executed: rollback_model -> scale_up -> routing_fallback.

incidents-bot: MITIGATION STATUS: rollback initiated, replicas scaled, fallback routing active, rate-limits applied. Observed error-rate drop: 504s from ~18% -> ~3% in the last 3 minutes. Latency p95 reduced ~350ms.

oncall-tom: current status = partial mitigation. Majority of customer traffic restored; a small subset still experiencing intermittent failures (mainly long-context requests). Continuing to monitor. ETA next update 10m.

sre-jen: logs indicate kv-cache eviction thrash on a subset of pods; adding extra mem-backed cache buffer as experiment on two pods.

eng-raj: will avoid another rollout until we have heatmap for seq-length distribution. tagging model-team to add guardrails.

support-maria: pasted public status update in support channel and replied to open tickets. Template used: "We're investigating increased failures in APAC hosted inference. We've applied mitigations (rollback, scaling, routing fallback). More updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1847654321"

product-lina: :thumbsup: Thanks team. please capture timeline for postmortem.

oncall-tom: acknowledged. Postmortem owners: @sre-jen (SRE lead), @eng-raj (model rollout owner), @eng-runtime (runtime). I'll file incident and assign.

incidents-bot: NEXT UPDATE: ~10 minutes or earlier if status changes. If you have relevant metrics dashboards add them here. Internal runbook and notes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-hosted-latency.

support-maria: customers asking about credits — recommending 1-2 days of usage credit for impacted orgs, await PM approval.

oncall-tom: standing by; monitoring logs/alerts. will publish final incident summary when stable.

sre-jen: recording current heap/profile snapshots and saving to runbook for postmortem.

eng-runtime: leaving rollback + fallback in place until we validate v3.1.2 root cause. will coordinate safe rollout gating next week.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT STATE: partial mitigation (degraded -> recovering). public page updated. thread locked for essential updates only.
